莉莉霍瓦特能觉察到普通人未注意到的细节，将春天即将来临的消息传递给还在冬眠的生物（×1包括幽灵、亡灵等。）。这妖精通过的地方，会出现春天的暖气。

和其他妖精一样，不清楚住处。除了春天之外的季节很少见到。
所以，莉莉也被称为春之季语。

Because of the outright hostility from Brightleaf Elves, they joined a Wither Elf community protected and led by an old and powerful mage. It is here that Denetia learnt the art of magic and appraisal.

One custom of the community was for teenage members to take on a younger member of the community of the same sex as a "step sibling", the elder sibling would then instruct the younger in the arts of magic. Denetia was ecstatic to learn that her new sibling, Ephemeral, was extremely beautiful and eventually developed a relationship which crossed boundaries. When the village protector fell ill and the neighbouring human community sought the lands of the Wither Elf community for development, the village was split into two as Denetia sided with those who wished to avoid conflict while Ephemeral headed the faction which sought retaliation. In their desperation, Ephemeral's faction heeded the call of the Evil Deity who promised their enemies would all die provided the faction help the Deity's resurrection.

Ephemeral at the last minute opted to betray the Deity after sensing its true intentions, but her betrayal and that of her brethren was detected and the ritual magic backfired on the members, turning them into stone statues. Denetia learnt about Ephemeral's fate and spent over a century refining her skills and abilities in hopes of reaching the mountain where Ephemeral was. Her goal had two steps: Retrieving Ephemeral's statue for safe keeping and finding the original grimoire written by the Deity's disciples which had the power to reverse the spell of petrification.

Midori met Kazuhiko and the gang several years before the story began. She was a member of the swimming club and was usually by herself before she met our protagonist.
She was an incredibly good swimmer, but a car accident ended her prospects. The damage to her spine was permanent, and cost her the use of her left leg.

Still, Midori is weighed down by her inability to walk to the point that she feels no one would find her attractive. This has effectively destroyed any hope she had for a relationship. Midori also feels like she is a burden to others, and prefers to do things on her own. While she tries to use her cheerful disposition to hide these feelings, they have not gone unnoticed. Her father in particular has noticed it, and even mentions that Midori's "true" smile seems to come out only when she's around our protagonist.

segments.text: A passenger of the first class nocturnal car.
He is an opium trafficker employed by a public agency that is in conflict with an agency in an Oriental country.
He is on board the Magic Arrow to smuggle Persian red opium, a high-quality opium.
When the train departs on time after confirming that Akutagawa is on board, it is safe to say that Chen's goal has been achieved.

He had no intention of succeeding in smuggling opium, and he was the one who tipped off the agency about the opium smuggling route being developed on the Trans-Europe Express. The bait was himself. The Agency will surely appoint Akutagawa to the position. However, he is retiring, not turning himself in, and has no intention of being arrested and detained.

For what it's worth, Chen is a softie. He is stingy with small change, but not with large sums of money. He has a childish side, with a fondness for dried potatoes. He always wears a smile as if he can see right through people's hearts, or in other words, like Akutagawa, he has no facial expression. He is reluctant to reveal his true feelings and acts in an almost dehumanizing manner. He carries a small spinning top as a good-luck charm.
He is divorced. He carries a Hino Komuro-style automatic pistol and is an expert sniper.
Deid Mann was the victim in the second KG-8 incident. He was a staff member of the Cohdopian Embassy in the United States.

Quercus Alba, Cohdopia's ambassador to the United States, was the leader of the smuggling ring, and he saw Mann as a threat once he submitted himself as a witness to the embassy's smuggling activities. In addition to this, the Yatagarasu had stolen a special key from the embassy and was closing in on its target, the mastermind of the ring. Alba tasked one of his agents, who was spying on the Yatagarasu as a mole, to neutralize both of these threats. To this end, "Calisto Yew", as the agent called herself, hired a hitman, Mack Rell, to kill Mann. However, he was caught on camera, and promptly arrested.
